summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtin helper, not committed. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `import enum` and EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) with the eleven members from the spec, each commented with meaning and type. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins between botocore.endpoint and botocore.signers; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept endpoint_config=None (treated as no variant tags); added public compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean, plus private _compute_sdk_endpoint. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added the enum import and TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (22 tests, one per behavioral criterion, derived from unittest.TestCase). Choices: absent SDK::Endpoint is None; FIPS/DualStack use the bridge's private _resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint; Accelerate and UseArnRegion pass raw config values through; "default client config" in tests read as Config(). Verification: 721 tests passed across test_args, test_regions, test_client, test_endpoint, test_utils using the prepared venv. The one over-79-column line in args.py (line 315) predates this change. tests/unit/test_args.py changed on disk mid-session; its content includes my additions, so I left it alone.
